passages.text: Now the allotment for the clans of the tribe of Judah extended to the border of Edom, to the Wilderness of Zin at the extreme southern boundary: Their southern border started at the bay on the southern tip of the Salt Sea, proceeded south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continued on to Zin, went over to the south of Kadesh-barnea, ran past Hezron up to Addar, and curved toward Karka.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Judah had many clans.
God gave land to these clans.
This land was their inheritance.
Their land reached the border of Edom.
It also reached the Wilderness of Zin.
This was at the far south of the land.
Their southern border began at the bay.
This bay was at the southern tip of the Salt Sea.
The border went south of the Ascent of Akrabbim.
It continued on to Zin.
The border passed south of Kadesh-barnea.
It went past Hezron.
It went up to Addar.
Then the border curved toward Karka.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י הַגּוֹרָ֗ל לְמַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם אֶל־ גְּב֨וּל אֱד֧וֹם מִדְבַּר־ צִ֛ן נֶ֖גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֥ה תֵימָֽן׃ וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִקְצֵ֖ה יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֑לַח מִן־ הַלָּשֹׁ֖ן הַפֹּנֶ֥ה נֶֽגְבָּה׃ וְ֠יָצָא אֶל־ מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה וְעָלָ֥ה מִנֶּ֖גֶב לְקָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְעָבַ֤ר חֶצְרוֹן֙ וְעָלָ֣ה אַדָּ֔רָה וְנָסַ֖ב הַקַּרְקָֽעָה׃

passages.text: It proceeded to Azmon, joined the Brook of Egypt, and ended at the Sea. This was their southern border.
passages.sermon:
The border of the tribe of Judah continued to Azmon.
The border reached the Brook of Egypt.
The border ended at the Sea.
This border marked the southern boundary for the tribe of Judah.
passages.original: וְעָבַ֣ר עַצְמ֗וֹנָה וְיָצָא֙ נַ֣חַל מִצְרַ֔יִם וְהָיָה תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָ֑מָּה זֶה־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃

passages.text: The eastern border was the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern border started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan, went up to Beth-hoglah, proceeded north of Beth-arabah, and went up to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Judah received land.
This land had clear borders.
The eastern border was the Salt Sea.
This border reached as far as the mouth of the Jordan River.
The northern border began at the bay of the Salt Sea.
This bay was at the mouth of the Jordan River.
The border went up to Beth-hoglah.
It passed north of Beth-arabah.
The border continued up to the Stone of Bohan.
Bohan was the son of Reuben.
passages.original: וּגְב֥וּל קֵ֙דְמָה֙ יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לַח עַד־ קְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וּגְב֞וּל לִפְאַ֤ת צָפ֙וֹנָה֙ מִלְּשׁ֣וֹן הַיָּ֔ם מִקְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃ וְעָלָ֤ה הַגְּבוּל֙ בֵּ֣ית חָגְלָ֔ה וְעָבַ֕ר מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְבֵ֣ית הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּב֔וּל אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן־ רְאוּבֵֽן׃

passages.text: Then the border went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, turning north to Gilgal, which faces the Ascent of Adummim south of the ravine. It continued along the waters of En-shemesh and came out at En-rogel.
passages.sermon:
The border went up to Debir.
It started from the Valley of Achor.
The border turned north toward Gilgal.
Gilgal faces the Ascent of Adummim.
The Ascent of Adummim is south of the ravine.
The border continued to the waters of En-shemesh.
The border ended at En-rogel.
passages.original: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֥וּל׀ דְּבִרָה֮ מֵעֵ֣מֶק עָכוֹר֒ וְצָפ֜וֹנָה פֹּנֶ֣ה אֶל־ הַגִּלְגָּ֗ל אֲשֶׁר־ נֹ֙כַח֙ לְמַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִנֶּ֖גֶב לַנָּ֑חַל וְעָבַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ אֶל־ מֵי־ עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו אֶל־ עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל׃

passages.text: From there the border went up the Valley of Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem) and ascended to the top of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.sermon:
The border started at the Valley of Hinnom.
The border went up along the southern slope of the Jebusites.
The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem.
The border then ascended to the top of the hill.
This hill faces the Valley of Hinnom on the west side.
The hill stands at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
passages.original: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל גֵּ֣י בֶן־ הִנֹּ֗ם אֶל־ כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב הִ֖יא יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר עַל־ פְּנֵ֤י גֵֽי־ הִנֹּם֙ יָ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁ֛ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה עֵֽמֶק־ רְפָאִ֖ים צָפֹֽנָה׃

passages.text: From the hilltop the border curved to the spring of the Waters of Nephtoah, proceeded to the cities of Mount Ephron, and then bent around toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).
passages.sermon:
This passage describes the border of the land given to the tribe of Judah.
The border started at the top of the hill.
It curved to the spring called the Waters of Nephtoah.
The border then went to the cities on Mount Ephron.
After that, the border bent around toward Baalah.
Baalah is also called Kiriath-jearim.
passages.original: וְתָאַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל מֵרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֶל־ מַעְיַן֙ מֵ֣י נֶפְתּ֔וֹחַ וְיָצָ֖א אֶל־ עָרֵ֣י הַר־ עֶפְר֑וֹן וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔ה הִ֖יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים׃

passages.text: The border curled westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Chesalon), went down to Beth-shemesh, and crossed to Timnah.
passages.sermon:
The border of the land of Judah started at Baalah.
It turned west toward Mount Seir.
The border passed along the northern slope of Mount Jearim.
Mount Jearim is also called Chesalon.
The border went down to Beth-shemesh.
It crossed over to Timnah.
passages.original: וְנָסַב֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִבַּעֲלָ֥ה יָ֙מָּה֙ אֶל־ הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר וְעָבַ֕ר אֶל־ כֶּ֧תֶף הַר־ יְעָרִ֛ים מִצָּפ֖וֹנָה הִ֣יא כְסָל֑וֹן וְיָרַ֥ד בֵּֽית־ שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְעָבַ֥ר תִּמְנָֽה׃

passages.text: Then it went out to the northern slope of Ekron, curved toward Shikkeron, proceeded to Mount Baalah, went on to Jabneel, and ended at the Sea.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes the boundary of the land given to the descendants of Judah.
The border went out to the northern slope of Ekron.
The border curved toward Shikkeron.
The border passed Mount Baalah.
The border went on to Jabneel.
The border ended at the Sea.
passages.original: וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־ כֶּ֣תֶף עֶקְרוֹן֮ צָפוֹנָה֒ וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ שִׁכְּר֔וֹנָה וְעָבַ֥ר הַר־ הַֽבַּעֲלָ֖ה וְיָצָ֣א יַבְנְאֵ֑ל וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָֽמָּה׃

passages.text: And the western border was the coastline of the Great Sea. These are the boundaries around the clans of the descendants of Judah.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Judah were a tribe in Israel.
They had many clans.
Their land had clear boundaries.
The western border was the coastline.
This coastline was called the Great Sea.
These are the boundaries that surrounded the clans of Judah.
passages.original: וּגְב֣וּל יָ֔ם הַיָּ֥מָּה הַגָּד֖וֹל וּגְב֑וּל זֶ֠ה גְּב֧וּל בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֛ה סָבִ֖יב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: According to the LORD’s command to him, Joshua gave Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion among the sons of Judah—Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)
passages.sermon:
Caleb was the son of Jephunneh.
The LORD gave a command to Joshua.
Joshua obeyed the LORD.
Joshua gave Caleb a portion of land.
This land was among the people of Judah.
The land was called Kiriath-arba.
Kiriath-arba is also called Hebron.
Arba was the forefather of Anak.
passages.original: וּלְכָלֵ֣ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֗ה נָ֤תַן חֵ֙לֶק֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ אֶת־ קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע אֲבִ֥י הָעֲנָ֖ק הִ֥יא חֶבְרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak—the descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
passages.sermon:
Caleb was a leader among the people of Judah.
Caleb went to the city of Hebron.
Hebron was also called Kiriath-arba.
Anak was the forefather of a group of giants.
Three sons of Anak lived in Hebron.
Their names were Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
Caleb drove out these three sons of Anak from Hebron.
Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai were descendants of Anak.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤רֶשׁ מִשָּׁם֙ כָּלֵ֔ב אֶת־ שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הָעֲנָ֑ק אֶת־ שֵׁשַׁ֤י וְאֶת־ אֲחִימַן֙ וְאֶת־ תַּלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָעֲנָֽק׃

passages.text: From there he marched against the inhabitants of Debir (formerly known as Kiriath-sepher).
passages.sermon:
Caleb was the son of Jephunneh.
God commanded Joshua to give Caleb a portion among the sons of Judah.
Joshua gave Caleb the city called Kiriath-arba, which is Hebron.
Arba was the forefather of Anak.
Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak from Hebron.
Their names were Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
They were descendants of Anak.
After this, Caleb went up from Hebron.
He marched against the people living in Debir.
Debir was once called Kiriath-sepher.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַל מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י דְּבִ֑ר וְשֵׁם־ דְּבִ֥ר לְפָנִ֖ים קִרְיַת־ סֵֽפֶר׃

passages.text: And Caleb said, “To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.”
passages.sermon:
Caleb was a leader of Israel.
Caleb spoke to the people.
Caleb said, “Whoever attacks Kiriath-sepher and captures it will receive a reward.”
Caleb promised, “I will give my daughter Acsah to that man as a wife.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כָּלֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר־ יַכֶּ֥ה אֶת־ קִרְיַת־ סֵ֖פֶר וּלְכָדָ֑הּ וְנָתַ֥תִּי ל֛וֹ אֶת־ עַכְסָ֥ה בִתִּ֖י לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: So Othniel son of Caleb’s brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
passages.sermon:
Othniel was the son of Kenaz.
Kenaz was the brother of Caleb.
Othniel captured the city.
Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to Othniel as a wife.
passages.original: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָ֛הּ עָתְנִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ קְנַ֖ז אֲחִ֣י כָלֵ֑ב וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֛וֹ אֶת־ עַכְסָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What do you desire?”
passages.sermon:
Acsah was Caleb’s daughter.
Othniel was Acsah’s husband.
Acsah came to Othniel.
Acsah urged Othniel to ask her father Caleb for a field.
Acsah got off her donkey.
Caleb saw Acsah.
Caleb spoke to Acsah.
Caleb asked Acsah, “What do you desire?”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹאָ֗הּ וַתְּסִיתֵ֙הוּ֙ לִשְׁא֤וֹל מֵֽאֵת־ אָבִ֙יהָ֙ שָׂדֶ֔ה וַתִּצְנַ֖ח מֵעַ֣ל הַחֲמ֑וֹר וַיֹּֽאמֶר־ לָ֥הּ כָּלֵ֖ב מַה־ לָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: “Give me a blessing,” she answered. “Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.” So Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs.
passages.sermon:
Acsah was Caleb’s daughter.
Acsah spoke to her father Caleb.
Acsah said, “Give me a blessing.”
Acsah said, “You have given me land in the Negev.”
Acsah said, “Give me springs of water also.”
Caleb gave Acsah the upper springs.
Caleb gave Acsah the lower springs.
passages.original: וַתֹּ֜אמֶר תְּנָה־ לִּ֣י בְרָכָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֶ֤רֶץ הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ נְתַתָּ֔נִי וְנָתַתָּ֥ה לִ֖י גֻּלֹּ֣ת מָ֑יִם וַיִּתֶּן־ לָ֗הּ אֵ֚ת גֻּלֹּ֣ת עִלִּיּ֔וֹת וְאֵ֖ת גֻּלֹּ֥ת תַּחְתִּיּֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: This is the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Judah.
passages.sermon: The tribe of Judah received land as their inheritance.\r\nThe families of Judah divided this land among themselves.\r\nThis inheritance belonged to the clans of Judah.
passages.original: זֹ֗את נַחֲלַ֛ת מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: These were the southernmost cities of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the border of Edom: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur, Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah, Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan, Ziph, Telem, Bealoth, Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron (that is, Hazor), Amam, Shema, Moladah, Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet, Hazar-shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah, Baalah, Iim, Ezem, Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah, Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah, Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon—twenty-nine cities in all, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Judah received land as their inheritance.
This land included cities in the south.
These cities were in the Negev.
The Negev is near the border of Edom.
The cities were Kabzeel, Eder, and Jagur.
They also included Kinah, Dimonah, and Adadah.
Kedesh, Hazor, and Ithnan were among them.
Ziph, Telem, and Bealoth were included.
Hazor-hadattah and Kerioth-hezron were also cities.
Kerioth-hezron is also called Hazor.
Amam, Shema, and Moladah were part of the list.
Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, and Beth-pelet were included.
Hazar-shual, Beersheba, and Biziothiah were among them.
Baalah, Iim, and Ezem were also cities.
Eltolad, Chesil, and Hormah were included.
Ziklag, Madmannah, and Sansannah were part of the list.
Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon were also cities.
There were twenty-nine cities in total.
These cities included their surrounding villages.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְי֣וּ הֶעָרִ֗ים מִקְצֵה֙ לְמַטֵּ֣ה בְנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל אֱד֖וֹם בַּנֶּ֑גְבָּה קַבְצְאֵ֥ל וְעֵ֖דֶר וְיָגֽוּר׃ וְקִינָ֥ה וְדִֽימוֹנָ֖ה וְעַדְעָדָֽה׃ וְקֶ֥דֶשׁ וְחָצ֖וֹר וְיִתְנָֽן׃ זִ֥יף וָטֶ֖לֶם וּבְעָלֽוֹת׃ וְחָצ֤וֹר׀ חֲדַתָּה֙ וּקְרִיּ֔וֹת חֶצְר֖וֹן הִ֥יא חָצֽוֹר׃ אֲמָ֥ם וּשְׁמַ֖ע וּמוֹלָדָֽה׃ וַחֲצַ֥ר גַּדָּ֛ה וְחֶשְׁמ֖וֹן וּבֵ֥ית פָּֽלֶט׃ וַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָ֛ל וּבְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וּבִזְיוֹתְיָֽה׃ בַּעֲלָ֥ה וְעִיִּ֖ים וָעָֽצֶם׃ וְאֶלְתּוֹלַ֥ד וּכְסִ֖יל וְחָרְמָֽה׃ וְצִֽקְלַ֥ג וּמַדְמַנָּ֖ה וְסַנְסַנָּֽה׃ וּלְבָא֥וֹת וְשִׁלְחִ֖ים וְעַ֣יִן וְרִמּ֑וֹן כָּל־ עָרִ֛ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וָתֵ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס

passages.text: These were in the foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah, Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam, Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah, Shaaraim, Adithaim, and Gederah (or Gederothaim)—fourteen cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Judah received an inheritance.
This inheritance included cities in the foothills.
These cities belonged to the clans of Judah.
The cities in the foothills were Eshtaol, Zorah, and Ashnah.
They also included Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam.
Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah were part of these cities.
Shaaraim, Adithaim, and Gederah (also called Gederothaim) were included.
There were fourteen cities in total.
Each city had its own villages.
passages.original: בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֑ה אֶשְׁתָּא֥וֹל וְצָרְעָ֖ה וְאַשְׁנָֽה׃ וְזָנ֙וֹחַ֙ וְעֵ֣ין גַּנִּ֔ים תַּפּ֖וּחַ וְהָעֵינָֽם׃ יַרְמוּת֙ וַעֲדֻלָּ֔ם שׂוֹכֹ֖ה וַעֲזֵקָֽה׃ וְשַׁעֲרַ֙יִם֙ וַעֲדִיתַ֔יִם וְהַגְּדֵרָ֖ה וּגְדֵרֹתָ֑יִם עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּֽע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal-gad, Dilan, Mizpeh, Joktheel, Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon, Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish, Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah—sixteen cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
These are cities in the territory of Judah.
They are located in the foothills.
Their names are Zenan, Hadashah, and Migdal-gad.
Dilan, Mizpeh, and Joktheel are also included.
Lachish, Bozkath, and Eglon are among them.
Cabbon, Lahmas, and Chitlish are part of this group.
Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah are included as well.
There are sixteen cities in total.
Each city has its own villages.
passages.original: צְנָ֥ן וַחֲדָשָׁ֖ה וּמִגְדַּל־ גָּֽד׃ וְדִלְעָ֥ן וְהַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה וְיָקְתְאֵֽל׃ לָכִ֥ישׁ וּבָצְקַ֖ת וְעֶגְלֽוֹן׃ וְכַבּ֥וֹן וְלַחְמָ֖ס וְכִתְלִֽישׁ׃ וּגְדֵר֕וֹת בֵּית־ דָּג֥וֹן וְנַעֲמָ֖ה וּמַקֵּדָ֑ה עָרִ֥ים שֵׁשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס

passages.text: Libnah, Ether, Ashan, Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib, Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah—nine cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
This passage lists cities in the territory of Judah.
These cities are Libnah, Ether, Ashan, Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib, Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah.
There are nine cities in total.
Each city includes its surrounding villages.
passages.original: לִבְנָ֥ה וָעֶ֖תֶר וְעָשָֽׁן׃ וְיִפְתָּ֥ח וְאַשְׁנָ֖ה וּנְצִֽיב׃ וּקְעִילָ֥ה וְאַכְזִ֖יב וּמָֽרֵאשָׁ֑ה עָרִ֥ים תֵּ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Ekron, with its towns and villages; from Ekron to the sea, all the cities near Ashdod, along with their villages; Ashdod, with its towns and villages; Gaza, with its towns and villages, as far as the Brook of Egypt and the coastline of the Great Sea.
passages.sermon:
This passage lists cities and their surrounding villages in the territory of Judah.
Ekron is a city.
Ekron has towns.
Ekron has villages.
The land stretches from Ekron to the sea.
All the cities near Ashdod are included.
These cities have villages.
Ashdod is a city.
Ashdod has towns.
Ashdod has villages.
Gaza is a city.
Gaza has towns.
Gaza has villages.
The land reaches as far as the Brook of Egypt.
The land reaches the coastline of the Great Sea.
These places mark the border.
passages.original: עֶקְר֥וֹן וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶֽיהָ׃ מֵעֶקְר֖וֹן וָיָ֑מָּה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ יַ֥ד אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ אַשְׁדּ֞וֹד בְּנוֹתֶ֣יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶ֗יהָ עַזָּ֥ה בְּנוֹתֶ֥יהָ וַחֲצֵרֶ֖יהָ עַד־ נַ֣חַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהַיָּ֥ם הַגָּבוֹל וּגְבֽוּל׃ס

passages.text: These were in the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh, Dannah, Kiriath-sannah (that is, Debir), Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim, Goshen, Holon, and Giloh—eleven cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
These cities were in the hill country of Judah.
Their names were Shamir, Jattir, and Socoh.
They also included Dannah and Kiriath-sannah.
Kiriath-sannah is also called Debir.
Anab, Eshtemoh, and Anim were among them.
Goshen, Holon, and Giloh were also included.
There were eleven cities in total.
Each city had its own villages.
passages.original: וּבָהָ֑ר שָׁמִ֥יר וְיַתִּ֖יר וְשׂוֹכֹֽה׃ וְדַנָּ֥ה וְקִרְיַת־ סַנָּ֖ה הִ֥יא דְבִֽר׃ וַעֲנָ֥ב וְאֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖ה וְעָנִֽים׃ וְגֹ֥שֶׁן וְחֹלֹ֖ן וְגִלֹ֑ה עָרִ֥ים אַֽחַת־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Arab, Dumah, Eshan, Janim, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah, Humtah, Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), and Zior—nine cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
These are cities in the hill country of Judah.
Their names are Arab, Dumah, and Eshan.
Janim, Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah are also included.
Humtah is one of these cities.
Kiriath-arba is another name for Hebron.
Zior is also listed among them.
There are nine cities in total.
Each city has its own villages.
passages.original: אֲרַ֥ב וְרוּמָ֖ה וְאֶשְׁעָֽן׃ וְיָנִים וּבֵית־ תַּפּ֖וּחַ וַאֲפֵֽקָה׃ וְחֻמְטָ֗ה וְקִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע הִ֥יא חֶבְר֖וֹן וְצִיעֹ֑ר עָרִ֥ים תֵּ֖שַׁע וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס

passages.text: Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah, Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah, Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah—ten cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
These are cities in the hill country of Judah.
Their names are Maon, Carmel, Ziph, and Juttah.
Their names are also Jezreel, Jokdeam, and Zanoah.
Their names are also Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah.
There are ten cities in total.
Each city has its own villages.
passages.original: מָע֥וֹן׀ כַּרְמֶ֖ל וָזִ֥יף וְיוּטָּֽה׃ וְיִזְרְעֶ֥אל וְיָקְדְעָ֖ם וְזָנֽוֹחַ׃ הַקַּ֖יִן גִּבְעָ֣ה וְתִמְנָ֑ה עָרִ֥ים עֶ֖שֶׂר וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor, Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon—six cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Judah received land.
Six cities were in this part of their land.
The names of the cities are Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor, Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon.
Each city had its own villages.
passages.original: חַלְח֥וּל בֵּֽית־ צ֖וּר וּגְדֽוֹר׃ וּמַעֲרָ֥ת וּבֵית־ עֲנ֖וֹת וְאֶלְתְּקֹ֑ן עָרִ֥ים שֵׁ֖שׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah—two cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
Kiriath-baal is also called Kiriath-jearim.
Rabbah is another city.
These are two cities.
Each city has its own villages.
passages.original: קִרְיַת־ בַּ֗עַל הִ֛יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים וְהָֽרַבָּ֑ה עָרִ֥ים שְׁתַּ֖יִם וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃ס

passages.text: These were in the wilderness: Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah, Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi—six cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
These places were in the wilderness.
Beth-arabah was one city.
Middin was another city.
Secacah was another city.
Nibshan was another city.
The City of Salt was another city.
En-gedi was another city.
There were six cities in total.
Each city had its own villages.
passages.original: בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר בֵּ֚ית הָעֲרָבָ֔ה מִדִּ֖ין וּסְכָכָֽה׃ וְהַנִּבְשָׁ֥ן וְעִיר־ הַמֶּ֖לַח וְעֵ֣ין גֶּ֑דִי עָרִ֥ים שֵׁ֖שׁ וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: But the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live there among the descendants of Judah.
passages.sermon:
The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem.
The tribe of Judah tried to drive out the Jebusites.
The descendants of Judah could not remove the Jebusites from Jerusalem.
The Jebusites still live in Jerusalem.
They live there among the descendants of Judah.
This situation continues to this day.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַיְבוּסִי֙ יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם לֹֽא־ יוּכְלוּ בְנֵֽי־ יְהוּדָ֖ה לְהֽוֹרִישָׁ֑ם וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב הַיְבוּסִ֜י אֶת־ בְּנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃פ
